## 🗑️ QuickTrash @TITLE@

@WARNING@

**Requirements:** Paper @PAPER@+, Java @JAVA@

### 📋 Changes since last release

@CHANGELOG@

### 📜 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| ------- | ----------- | ---------- |
| `/trash` | Open trash inventory | `quicktrash.use` |
| `/quicktrash version` | Show plugin version | — |
| `/quicktrash reload` | Reload configuration | `quicktrash.admin` |

### 🔧 Configuration

`plugins/QuickTrash/config.yml`:

- Trash auto-clear timeout (seconds)
- GUI title and info item text
- Valuable items list (materials that require confirmation)
- Confirmation window duration (seconds)
- Message customization

### 🧱 Compatibility

| Platform | Version | Support |
| -------- | ------- | ------- |
| **Paper** | @PAPER@+ | ✅ Recommended |
| **Purpur** | @PAPER@+ | ✅ Works |

### 📦 Installation

1. Download `QuickTrash-@VERSION@.jar` below
2. Place it in your `plugins/` folder
3. Restart your server (Paper @PAPER@+, Java @JAVA@)
